# Map label glyphs

`OpenSans-Regular/0-255.pbf`: MapLibre SDF glyphs for Open Sans Regular, Basic Latin + Latin-1
(parcel labels: property numbers such as PL58813 and areas in sq.m.). Served by the server at
`/editor/vendor/fonts/{fontstack}/{range}.pbf`, so labels need no internet access.

Source: https://github.com/openmaptiles/fonts (gh-pages, "Open Sans Regular").
Open Sans is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
